about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: James C. Justice

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REDESIGNATING A PLAYGROUND IN THE NEW RIVER GORGE NATIONAL PARK AND PRESERVE IN THE STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA AS THE "HEARTS OF GOLD PLAYGROUND"
statements.title: REDESIGNATING A PLAYGROUND IN THE NEW RIVER GORGE NATIONAL PARK AND PRESERVE IN THE STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA AS THE "HEARTS OF GOLD PLAYGROUND"
sentences: Whether it be the war in Iran or whatever it may be, we deal with tough stuff here every day, every single day.
Mr. President, with that being said, notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Senate proceed to the immediate consideration of Calendar No. 645, S. 2933.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 10-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF WEST VIRGINIA FLOODS
statements.title: 10-YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF WEST VIRGINIA FLOODS
sentences: I am telling you today is a day that I will never forget, and it is hard for me to talk without having big, giant tears in my eyes.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SENATE BILLS
statements.title: SENATE BILLS
sentences: Madam President, you know, I have got to say just this: We have Medal of Honor recipients with us right now, and I fast- forwarded because I had this beautiful speech to give and all that stuff, and there have been some things happened that we will get to in just a second.
So I am going to fast-forward and read something that we all thought was semi-impossible.
This monument that we have wanted to put on our National Mall that I am going to ask for your unanimous consent in just a second, absolutely we are there.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: In my backyard, two-thirds of the population of this entire country is within a rocks' throw of West Virginia.
Why in the world do we in America need to blow our own legs off and turn China loose, India loose, whomever it may be?
Now, let me go one step further, and let me just say just this: Let's just say we awaken to an opportunity of AI, data centers, whatever it may be, industry, manufacturing, whatever it may be.

I promise you, a year and a half from today, we are going to be in a situation that we are going to have to decide: Are we going to have opportunity and jobs and manufacturing and AI and data centers--are we going to have that--or are we going to choose with our electricity amounts that we have--we are either going to be able to support industry or we are going to have to support homes.
Absolutely just go back and think just one more thing: Civilization only progressed--only progressed with abundant, cheap energy, and now it is abundant, cheap, clean energy.
If we don't watch out, we are going to awaken to a situation, as far as energy in this country, that is really, really, really bad.
We can't do that because we are going to be in a situation with our grid and with our energy production in a year and a half from today.
But after we do all of that, I will bet you this in every way.
We will absolutely have to mind the store.
They can't do it because I am going to tell the truth.
Mr. President, I will follow these guidelines correctly and make sure I do.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Cabinet Nominations (Executive Session)
statements.title: Cabinet Nominations (Executive Session)
sentences: I can tell you, from the bottom of my heart--and I hope everyone will listen to just this--if we don't get a handle on our energy situation in this country, a year and a half from today, we will be deciding between homes and jobs.
We will be deciding between homes and opportunity for all of our people.
We will be deciding between homes and industry.
This is a great, great nominee, and I support him wholeheartedly, in every single way.
